individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial heatmap overlays on tissue sections are heatmap-type visualizations, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The spatial heatmap plots show continuous color-coded scores per spot without error bars, so there is nothing to define.

individual-data-points.explanation: The box plots are overlaid with individual data points (dots) representing each biological replicate.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)...
error-bars-defined.explanation: The caption defines the box (25th-75th percentile/IQR) and provides explicit minima, maxima, median, Q1 and Q3 values for each group, defining the whiskers and box elements.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment score line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The GSEA enrichment plots show a single running-score curve per gene set with no error bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each bar represents a single log2 fold-change value per gene from a DEG analysis, not an average across replicates, so individual points do not apply.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The bar chart shows single fold-change values with p-values annotated above bars, with no error bars present.

individual-data-points.explanation: This panel consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a quantification plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: This panel is a set of micrographs, not a plot, so error bars do not apply.
